description: Create a job alert: Ocean of Jobs emails the user new jobs that match the filter, at the times set in their preferences. Up to 5 alerts per account. The email goes to the address the account had when the token was made. Create one only when the user asks for it. Needs the user's personal access token.

filter.description: What the alert watches for. Every field is a string; give at least one.

salary_min.description: Lowest monthly salary in shekels, e.g. "30000".

search.description: Words to search for, as on the board, e.g. "devops".

seniority.description: Comma-separated: intern, junior, mid, senior, staff, principal, lead, manager, director, exec.

name: create_alert
title: Create a job alert
